description: We are building AgroSat PK, an AI and satellite-powered precision agriculture platform designed to help farmers adapt to changing climate conditions using NASA Earth observation data. Led by a full-stack developer skilled in Python, React, and AI integration, our goal is to deliver actionable crop health analytics, disease detection, and climate insights. We welcome teammates passionate about Earth data, UI/UX, or agri-tech!
summary: AgroSat PK is an innovative, AI-powered precision agriculture platform designed to support farmers and agricultural stakeholders by leveraging NASA Earth observation data. The project addresses the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge by integrating satellite imagery and environmental telemetry to monitor crop health, detect diseases early, and optimize resource utilization like water and fertilizers. It is crucial for climate resilience in agriculture, helping farmers make data-driven decisions to secure crop yields and food security in changing climatic conditions.
details:
- What it does & How it works: AgroSat PK uses satellite-based Earth observation data and AI intelligence to analyze crop health, monitor vegetation indices, and provide predictive insights for disease and weather anomalies affecting local farms.

- Benefits & Intended Impact: Empowers farmers with real-time analytics to reduce crop loss, optimize irrigation, and adapt sustainably to climate shifts, directly boosting agricultural productivity and income.

- Tools & Technologies: Built using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React.js, Python, Tailwind CSS, Vercel hosting, and integrated AI/satellite APIs.

- Creativity & Team Factors: Designed with a user-friendly mobile-first interface tailored for accessibility, ensuring even non-technical farmers or field operators can easily interpret complex satellite metrics.
dataRefs: NASA Earth Observation and Satellite Data
